tasks.title: Enforce non-negotiable negative scope boundaries and anti-goals for IncidentLens
tasks.description: Explicitly forbid speculative features, third-party trackers, unnecessary cloud services, and forced authentication barriers.
tasks.objective: Prevent scope creep and maintain minimal, resilient architecture.
acceptance_criteria: Third-party analytics and tracking beacons explicitly barred
No forced login walls or mandatory remote accounts for local operations
Speculative external cloud services rejected for bootstrap MVP

p0_mvp_scope: Core domain logic and robust execution pipeline
Responsive, accessible user interface adhering to WCAG AA tokens
Zero-network isolation and client-side data privacy by default
negative_scope_exclusions: NO premature third-party cloud analytics or telemetry trackers
NO speculative remote database dependencies during initial bootstrap
NO mandatory login walls or user registration barriers for local utility
